games.name: Gold Miner: Party Rush - Supporter Pack
Pegs of Hell
games.summary: A physics roguelike where you build the pachinko board yourself. Place and upgrade pegs, arrange powerful Arcana, split balls, trigger elemental chains and create absurd scoring machines before Hell's rent catches up with you.

games.name: Sir, We Have a Pit Problem! Demo
The Worldtree and the Omamori Promise
世界樹と護符の約束 - Phase 1：葉冠編
A Thousand Stamps
games.summary: Collect, sort, and organize hundreds of unique stamps across beautiful themed albums. Play alone or online with friends, create your own collections from photos, and enjoy the simple pleasure of putting everything in its place.

games.name: Alien Skies
games.summary: Blast through the cosmos in Alien Skies, a neo-classical side-scrolling space shooter! Pilot your starship across diverse alien worlds, unleash devastating weapon upgrades, and upgrade your ship to conquer an ever-growing alien threat.

games.name: Angel Investor Simulator
games.summary: Invest into promising startups. Help them grow with your team of experts. Capture the market share with quality product, smart pricing and marketing. Cash out big after the IPO. Compete with the other angels and show them who's the boss.

games.name: Arbeitszeitbetrug - Das Spiel
games.summary: THE ALIENS Need the Cows!Shoot and avoid the farmers in their home made planes while also trying to avoid the Armys rocket attack!Collect the cows that you have placed in the floating energy orbs so you can upgrade all the way to the Golden Mother ShipLots of endless fun it this classic shoot em up game with a fun twist

games.name: Asian Story
games.summary: Help a floating island restore life in VR

games.name: Attkand
games.summary: ÅTTKAND is a minimalist color puzzle. Tap a chip to see the reaction wave around the board. Use the special chips to change the waves. Turn all the chips to the same color to win.

games.name: Australia Did It: End-of-the-World Railway Defense Business
games.summary: Deploy and merge units into 1,500+ variations to defend your train in tight Turn-Based Strategy battles, then see if your build survives Autobattler journeys between stations against massive monster hordes. Build you crew. Defend the train. Deliver the cargo.

games.name: BALL PICKER - Clean Up the Golf Yard
games.summary: Collect +1,000,000 golf balls, earn money, buy new vehicles, and clean up the golf yard. BALL PICKER - Clean up the Golf Yard is an active incremental game centered on an organizing and relaxing experience.

games.name: Baroque Merchant ~ Echoes of Bach
games.summary: A city-building simulation where you freely create your own city on the water. Surrounded by Baroque music, watch merchants stroll through the streets and horse-drawn carriages pass by as you admire the cityscape and its architecture. We invite you to experience **A Moment of Tranquility**.

games.name: Below the Stone
games.summary:
Below the Stone is a punishing pixel art roguelike about dwarves questing to reach the deepest depths. Each and every descent will lead to new adventures, where only the most determined players with many risked lives will be rewarded by the hidden world that lies Below the Stone.

Discover the lore of dwarves, the treasures they die for, and the secrets they rarely speak of. Within the stone below lies the adventure everyone seeks, but there's always a price. Often death.

games.name: Block Garden
games.summary: A 3D puzzle game about bringing jelly blocks together. Blocks of the same color stick when they touch, and once they're stuck they move as one piece. Push them around small islands with a cat until each color is joined up.

games.name: Bounce On 2: Drallo's Demise
games.summary:
The anticipated sequel to the critically acclaimed platformer, Bounce On, is here!  Team Phobic is proud to release Bounce on 2: Drallo's Demise.

Roll your way through the Floating Ruins, explore space on the Orbital Platform, and finish the fight in Drallo's Fortress.  Customize your character, find hidden secrets, fight against unique bosses and collect gems!  With different level objectives to select, and over 100 keys to collect, Bounce On 2: Drallo's Demise will keep you playing and playing!

Bounce On 2 is Plus+ enabled.  Compete for best times on Plus+ leaderboards, finish awards, save game data online, and brag to friends on Twitter and Facebook.  Plus+ challenges will be added in an upcoming update.

Fans of the original will love the improvements, and newcomers to the series will have no problem jumping right in.  Bounce On 2 features incredible 2D/3D graphics, amazing lighting effects, and is packed with beautiful artwork and 21 unique musical tracks to add to the fun.  Use the accelorometer or touch controls.  The graphics scale to utilize the capabilities of newer devices.  

Bounce On 2: Drallo's Demise is suitable for all ages and skill levels.  With level difficulties ranging from super easy to near impossible, Bounce On 2 has something for everyone.

Team Phobic is dedicated to supporting and listening to our customers.  Don't hesitate to leave a review or contact us with your input. Follow us on twitter @teamphobic.

Start at the beginning of the adventure in Bounce On, and be sure to check out our other games: iTD and Micro Mayhem.  All are available in the App Store now!

games.name: Breachwall: Network Defense
games.summary: Defend a growing network against real-world cyberattacks - from a freelancer's home laptop to the quantum era. Place firewalls and 2FA, research new defenses, catch phishing emails, read the logs and decide what to save when everything is under attack.

games.name: Cable Management Simulator
games.summary: Cable Management Sim is a chill organizing game where you install cables to provide internet for a building. Plan, trace, measure and cut your cables for the perfect install. learn abilities, unlock mini games, customisation and build out your server room in a no pressure no rush environment.

games.name: Calculator - Desktop Mate Widgets Kizuna Akari DLC
Calculator - Desktop Mate Widgets Yuzuki Yukari DLC
CapyHaven
games.summary: Somewhere past the river, two capybaras found a meadow. Lead them: buy land and pick each tile's biome, build huts and hot springs, host festivals, welcome babies. Gentle day/night rhythm, full pacifist option, zero fail states. The coziest colony you'll ever run.

games.name: Clean vs. Dirty!
games.summary: The germs are attacking! Pick up your broom, conquer 30 progressively challenging levels, buy and upgrade cleaning tools, and face the endless wrath of Endless Mode! Every tool has unique perks, range, damage, and attack speed. Can you keep the bathroom clean?

games.name: Collabulator
games.summary: Collaborative Calculation has never been easier! Streamlined functionality meets masterful efficiency in the world’s FIRST and ONLY multi-user calculator. Now with Achievements!

games.name: Crusader Kings III: Silk & Silver
games.summary:
Steer a powerful merchant company through the medieval era in Silk & Silver, a Major Expansion for Crusader Kings III.

Master the trade system by striking profitable deals that will bring prosperity to your house and to realms across the world. Win over local authorities as you expand your business interests, or seize power in a Republic by defeating your rivals as you turn your trading monopolies into political power.

games.name: CRUSHCHOP
games.summary: From a hidden bastard son to the Lord of Sunlit City! Rebuild a burned realm through gambling in an arena of clashing warriors. You will gamble, rally soldiers, build castles, mine resources, raid giants, and do it all in CRUSHCHOP!

games.name: Curse of the Chronomancer
games.summary: Race against the clock in this top down action roguelike. Sacrifice time off of your hourglass to purchase upgrades that will either save you time in the long run, or ultimately lead to your destruction.

games.name: Death & Deadlines
games.summary: A darkly comic puzzle game about climbing Hell’s corporate ladder. You’re dead, back at a desk, and determined to work your way to the top—even if every demon in the building needs to be “let go.”

games.name: Deep Rock Galactic: Survivor - Knockout Expansion
Desktop Friends
games.summary: A voice-chat companion who lives on your desktop. Talk with two childhood friends, cheeky Tsumugi and gentle Hiyori, who remember you, start conversations on their own, set timers and notes by voice, and keep you company while you work. Japanese only (voice, text and interface).

games.name: Dungeonmancer (Perry's Game Dev)
games.summary: A solo action-exploration dungeon crawler about defeating monsters, collecting loot, and overcoming bosses.

games.name: Enamelist: Tidy Up the Pin Collection
games.summary: Enamelist is a cozy tidy-up simulator where you organize over 2,000 unique enamel pins into themed sets on pin boards. Enjoy beautiful artwork as you place each pin back where it belongs.

games.name: Espetero Simulator
games.summary: Become the king of the grill in the world's first Espetero Simulator! Master the art of skewering sardines, control the fire on the sand, and manage the rush hour of a busy chiringuito in the heart of the Costa del Sol. Can you handle the August heat, or will your business go up in smoke?

games.name: Everhex
games.summary: Destroy as many bubbles as possible in 60 seconds. Click on group of 2 or more bubbles of the same color and they will disappear. Number of point for each removed bubble depends on number of bubbles in the removed group. You will get more points for group of 6 cubes, then for 2 groups of 3 cubes. Game is over in 60 seconds. There are 3 game difficulties: 4, 5 and 6 colours on the board.

games.name: F Of X
games.summary: Embark on a journey through a digital world of functions, solving mathematical puzzles to move platforms and conquer platforming challenges. Test your logic to transcend as the Master of Functions.

games.name: Find100Buttons
games.summary: Find100Buttons is a first-person 3D adventure game where your goal is to find 100 hidden buttons. Explore the world, search every corner, discover secrets, and prepare for unexpected surprises along the way!

games.name: Game Shelver 99: I must organize my Steam Library and defend it against pirates with a shotgun
games.summary: Tennis Master - it is a great simulator of tennis racket! Your task to hit the ball as many times, as possible to complete the level.Chose the racket, choose the court and start the game!

games.name: Gold Mining Simulator - Definitive Edition
games.summary: Gold Mining Simulator: Definitive Edition is the ultimate version of the game, featuring all previously released expansions plus new content, gameplay enhancements, visual improvements, and numerous quality of life upgrades for the most complete gold mining experience.

games.name: Golfcremental
games.summary: BUILD! GOLF! EARN! BUY! Turn $50 into your own golfing empire by building custom golf courses and then automating them to get hole in ones. Unlock unique golf course pieces and use them in unique ways to make more money.

games.name: Help, My Capybaras Escaped!
games.summary: Help, My Capybaras Escaped is a casual and fun hidden object game where you have to rescue all the capybaras in various colourful images!

games.name: Hive Fall
games.summary: An expansive incremental game that rewards both active and idle gameplay. Defend your planet from an onslaught of alien insects, block projectiles, purchase upgrades, collect artifacts, and complete missions for rewards. There is always something new to unlock as you progress deeper into the swarm.

games.name: Idol Lust
games.summary: Idol Lust is an idle strategy game combining strategy and RPG. As the manager of agency "LUCKY", you willl guide idols on stage and lead them to fight "U-Mutations" to protect New Tokyo!

games.name: Imperium Sine Fine: Eternal Emperor
games.summary: Your generals grow old. Your cities grow restless. Your empire need not end. Lead one of 14 factions in a living fantasy world of grand strategy, where populations migrate, crime festers, and every grain shipment matters. Build, conquer, and rule, without end.

games.name: Infinipop
games.summary: A game about popping bubble sheets with your brain switched off. Except every rebirth gives you a new way to pop: drag, multi-pop, full-board shatter, one-hit crush. The faster you clear, the more the screen fills with effects. Ten materials, ten sounds. Twenty board shapes. Endless stages.

games.name: Iron & Instinct
games.summary: Raid dungeons, collect monster eggs, and hatch your own army. As the Break Knight, raise your monsters on the ranch, pick your strongest for your party, and fight side by side through ever more dangerous dungeons in this 2D monster-raising RPG.

games.name: Leeway
games.summary: Buy cheap, sell dear, and don't sink. Or rob everyone and spend the gold before the navy catches you. Leeway is a physics-first age-of-sail game where every knot of wind and every ton of cargo matters. Peer-to-peer multiplayer.

games.name: Legacy of Legend
games.summary: Face-down bluffing and piercing strikes! 1v1 tactical turn-based card battle.

games.name: Link Loop
games.summary: Link Loop is a physics-based 2D puzzle-platformer built around portals, momentum, and objects. Use your portals to overcome obstacles and bend the world!

games.name: Linkominoes
games.summary: Linkominoes is a strategic puzzle game about overlapping squares. Careful placement and spatial planning are essential as unique challenges demand different tactical approaches.

games.name: Little Noel: Christmas Village
games.summary: Build and decorate your own little Christmas Village! Relax and build to your heart's content in this cozy sandbox game. No objectives, no stress building.

games.name: Marbles: Tidy Up
games.summary: Turn colorful chaos into satisfying order. Collect 1,800 marbles, sort them into matching jars, and unlock handy upgrades. A cozy little game to enjoy at your own pace...

games.name: Mayday Airways
games.summary: A 1-4 player co-op airline comedy. Run a tiny island airline with your friends, keep a falling-apart plane in the air, fix it mid-flight and keep a full cabin of passengers happy. Or at least alive.

games.name: Melvor Idle 2: A RuneScape Adventure Soundtrack
Nations Beyond Earth
games.summary: Lead a nation through an alternate-history space race. Build cities and industry, expand across worlds, manage trade and diplomacy, command armies and fleets, and compete for control of a living Solar System in single-player or multiplayer.

games.name: No Sleep Tonight
games.summary: No Sleep Tonight is an incremental game about counting sheep and late-night inspiration. You keep trying to fall asleep, only to get back up to jot down another idea. Your eyelids grow heavier, but the workshop in your head only gets busier…

games.name: Observation Post 7
games.summary: A dystopian surveillance sim. Work the CCTV cameras of Observation Post 7: spot the crime, judge the citizens, meet your quota. Then walk home through five island cities to the daughter who waits for you. Every report has a price. Every choice decides how it ends.

games.name: OKUREK
games.summary: Tend the farm, the chickens, the grieving jars. The trees murmur while the cancer grows with every passing day. A 90-min folk-horror experience set in the rotting mountains of Czech Switzerland. Preserve what you couldn't save.

games.name: Picky Numbers
games.summary: Picky Numbers is a game based on lottery mechanics. Buy tickets, choose numbers, and watch as the drum draws results one by one. The more numbers you hit, the bigger the payout. Each ticket is a different strategy, with higher risk and higher reward, or a JACKPOT.

games.name: Pill & Chill
games.summary: Sort a tabletop full of colorful pills with a counting spatula. Pill & Chill is a relaxing, physics-based organizing game with no timer, no score, and lots of satisfying little sounds.

games.name: Scrap Cascade
games.summary: Turn junk into a chain reaction in a compact factory strategy game. Connect machines, recycle waste and pick upgrade cards that change your plan. Grow through five contracts, adapt to new buyers and build a production line worth running again.

games.name: Shadow at Noon
games.summary: An interactive sound novel for honkaku mystery fans. No cutscenes, no spectacle: just text, art and sound, with every clue you need on the page. Amesaka, 2015. A rich family's eldest son lies dead at the foot of his stairs; by morning the housekeeper has confessed. Every confession hides one lie.

games.name: Shirt Happens!
games.summary: Build a t-shirt brand with your friends online, or run the whole shop solo. Draw your own prints, then cut, sew, overlock and press every shirt by hand. Want a real factory? Bring up to 10. Do a bit of everything, or pick one station and master it.

games.name: Slightly Used Sorcery
games.summary: Run a cozy magical pawnshop where you buy cursed junk, uncover ridiculous enchantments, craft bizarre artifacts, haggle with eccentric customers, and turn magical trash into profit.

games.name: Sort A Lot - Sheep
games.summary: A cozy first-person sorting game. One big meadow, 2,200 mixed-up sheep, 24 farms around a barn, and a vacuum that sucks sheep in and throws them into the right pen. Read the wool, the brand and the ear tag, fill every pen, and sit on a bench when the rain comes.

games.name: Sort Them Frogs
games.summary: A greenhouse full of tiny frogs, and every one needs a place. Collect and sort 6,000 figures across 300 designs and 30 themes. Earn coins, upgrade your basket and turn a wonderfully messy shop into a collection you can admire.

games.name: Sploink
games.summary: Up to eight ducks. Twenty-five waves of angrier ducks. Hold a farmhouse roof, drop a squad of rifle ducks, pump a Bee-M-G through the Quack-a-Punch and bring down the Great Honk. A free, chaotic co-op wave shooter where every bad idea is a feature.

games.name: Stash Mayhem
games.summary: A fast-paced warehouse-sorting roguelike. Items keep arriving and customers keep ordering, so organize everything your way and deliver each order before their patience runs out. Carry too much at once and it all spills to the floor.

games.name: Stevedore
games.summary: No more job in the city. Managed to find one in the middle of nowhere. Stevedore. Crane worker. It feels off, but you need money. Stevedore is a short industrial horror game where you take a role of a crane worker. Lift containers, load ships and complete your contract. What could go wrong?

games.name: Super Plants
games.summary: Super Plants is a short tower defense game about planting and growing super plants to defend against pests. Defeat enemies to unlock new plants and abilities, and grow the best defense.

games.name: The Heir: Steampunk Escape Room
games.summary: You have been chosen by Dr. Voss as heir to his scientific legacy. Explore his mysterious laboratory, solve ingenious puzzles rooted in Victorian science, and discover that the laboratory hides a secret far darker than Voss led you to believe.

games.name: The Magician: Tidy Up the Magic Decks!
games.summary: A cozy single-player simulation where you play as a magician bringing order to a magical mess. Search for scattered cards, sort them into their proper decks, and use your magic to tidy up. Don't forget to find your missing rabbits and doves along the way!

games.name: Tidy Up the Wonderlands of Mirad
games.summary: Sort 2500+ tiny lands in this cozy tidy-up. Each piece rises as real land you can walk on, and every one earns you upgrades.

games.name: Tidy Up: Bricks n Blocks
games.summary: Thousands of toy bricks are tipped across the floor. Sort every piece onto the right bookcase by shape, then into the right bin by color. Earn tokens, buy faster ways to tidy, from bigger pockets to sorting drones, and clear 13 rooms plus a Chaos Mode with all 114 shapes.

games.name: Time Well Spent: Tidy Up the Watch Shop
games.summary: An elegant watch shop lies in chaos: over 1,000 watches are scattered across two floors. Read each dial, recognise its brand and its mechanism, and return every piece to its cabinet in this cozy tidy-up game, all while a narrated story about time and life unfolds.

games.name: Underbloom
games.summary: Under a forest that forgot how to grow, one small mushroom wakes up. Spread a glowing web through nine hidden worlds, meet their small, strange neighbours, and wake the Heartseed. A cozy incremental game with a real ending.

games.name: Unexpected Number Neighbour
games.summary: An unknown number texts you at work. She’s cute, flirty, ginger… and her bust keeps growing for no clear reason. Reply carefully, don’t slack off too much, and unlock every ending in this short texting visual novel.

games.name: Unhistorical Warfare
games.summary: Command 30+ historical armies across 3,000 years of warfare, from Persian spearmen to Abrams tanks, in real-time pixel-art battles where every soldier fights and flees on his own. Then deploy the anomalies: trolls, zombies, wizards, flying saucers and more!

games.name: Unicorn Academy: Island of Magic
games.summary: You are invited to join Unicorn Academy! Create a magical connection with your own unicorn and forge friendship bonds with Sophia, Ava, Layla and the other heroes from the se-ries. Wield unicorn magic and discover every corner of Unicorn Island.

games.name: Wreck and Repeat
games.summary: An incremental crime sandbox. Outrun the cops and ramp up the citywide chaos. Drive anywhere in a procedural cyberpunk city where everything is destructible. Throw explosives, run over pedestrians, and spend your score on unlocks, upgrades, and bigger rides.

games.name: 10 calls
games.summary: Death has crashed the office Halloween party, scythe in hand and pumpkin on its head! Fight back, wreck the office, or haunt your colleagues as a ghost. Play as Death and unleash hell. To escape, just answer the phone. Preferably before you’re sliced in half.

games.name: Above Par
games.summary: Above Par is a physics-based precision platformer about climbing high and falling hard. Master a 4-club toolkit, calculate your trajectories, and get ready to fall... a lot.

games.name: AI Lab Tycoon
games.summary: AI Lab Tycoon drops you into the infancy of the AI revolution in 2016. Starting with nothing but a check from a skeptical investor, you'll build an empire of superintelligence over the course of two decades. Can you lead the greatest technological revolution in human history?

games.name: Bank Vault: Tidy Up Together
games.summary: Organize a bank vault packed with 2,345 unique items! Sort cash, gold, and precious treasures, arrange every shelf, and turn chaos into order. Team up with friends in this satisfying tidying adventure!

games.name: BEAR THE BURN: A Stock Market Deckbuilder
games.summary: Bear The Burn is a ruthless desktop-overlay stock market deckbuilder. Buy illegal trading cards, manipulate live market charts, and chase massive multipliers. Will you cash out early or risk the ultimate margin call?

games.name: Bomb Them Ores
games.summary: Why swing a pickaxe when you can blow the whole cave up? Bomb Them Ores is a chaotic incremental arcade game where bigger explosions mean better loot. Go deep, go loud, and find the treasure hiding far below.

games.name: Bullet Factory
games.summary: A factory that makes bullets, turrets that fire them, and a horde of living scrap that wants your metal. Design your ammo module by module, from junkyard tinkering to the far future, coached over the radio by Granny Odette.

games.name: Cabbie Chaos
games.summary: An over-the-top arcade taxi game for 1–8 players, set in a crazy world full of nonsense! Grab a passenger and get them to their destination by any means necessary — over ramps, through parks, across frozen lakes and down into the sewers. Drive fast, drive crazy, and get paid for it!

games.name: Chromagami
games.summary: Team up with a comrade to fight an interdimensional paper war in this science-fiction, hero shooter.

games.name: Cinderpeak
games.summary: Carry the last flame up a mountain that has gone dark. Cinderpeak is a hard, precise 2D platformer: jump, climb and dash through ten chapters, each with its own rule, with a flame on your head that is starting to remember who put it out.

games.name: CLACKPOT: Marble Bounce Roguelike
games.summary: A marble-bouncing roguelike! Pull back, let go, and score on every wall bounce. Combine balls with their own quirks, Patches and Relics across 24 interlocking Synergies into a build that's all your own, then climb higher past 53 rule-bending bosses!

games.name: Classroom in Sora
games.summary: A laid-back sci-fi adventure about making friends at a school in space (Sora). You play a friend-seeking, space-born human at a new school full of alien students of every species. Talk to everyone—grow close or drift apart—and uncover the mystery hidden within the school.

games.name: Dark Rail
games.summary: Turn-based management roguelike. Command the Inquisition and rule an industrial city on the empire’s edge. Use your train to meet prisoner shipment quotas by hunting heretics and slaying magical beasts. Produce supplies, contain revolt, and sacrifice prisoners to stop the madness.

games.name: Debt Clicker
games.summary: A satirical clicker where the goal isn't to get rich: it's to owe as much as possible. Click your credit card, spend what you borrow, sign every loan, and climb from a broke apartment to a mortgage on the Sun and a loan against Reality itself.

games.name: DEEPest RESEARCH
games.summary: “I want to kill the man who took the one I love.” And so, she… His missing wife’s phone holds a side of her he never knew: a honeyed voice, sultry breaths, strange men. Sickened, her lawyer husband seeks the truth. But he has secrets too… A phone-snooping mystery adventure of forbidden thrill!

games.name: Disney Dreamlight Valley: The Keepsake Sea
games.platforms: PS5 · Xbox · Switch 2 · Switch · PC · PS4
games.summary:
Get ready to dive into an entirely new adventure as you become a magical Merfolk and embark on a sweeping journey across the sea to reach a faraway kingdom, where strange echoes of its past await. Along the way, you’ll meet some unforgettable new friends, including Milo Thatch, Captain Jack Sparrow, and Megara, as you uncover the mysteries waiting beyond the waves.

The Keepsake Sea will introduce brand-new Biomes to explore, mysterious underwater areas to uncover, and new spaces to fully customize. From exploring what lies beneath the surface to discovering the secrets of this faraway kingdom, there’s plenty of adventure waiting for you!

games.name: Dotty Bead: Wonders of the Cloudy Candy House
Expediente Herodes
games.summary: Truth or Dare is our SPIN (thank you) on a classic party game!WHAT IS TRUTH OR DARE?Truth or Dare uses a spinning wheel to decide your fate. Sit in a circle with your friends, choose someone to go first. That person is the dare master and must pick someone to be their victim. They must let their victim spin the wheel. Once it stops the daremaster must ask their victim either a deep dark truth or dare them to do something. Once the victim has completed their task or confessed all their darkest secrets, they become the daremaster and must pick another victim!FEATURES? An exciting new way to decide your fate? Beautiful retina graphics for all your iOS devices ? Play with any number of your friendsCOMING SOON? New wheels? New languagesAny comments, problems or feature requests tweet us at http://twitter.com/pixelgrazing

games.name: Expeditionary Sustainment Command
games.summary: Command a U.S. Army Sustainment Company in a punishing military strategy campaign. Scout threats, clear routes, escort supplies, and lead armored and infantry offensives. Upgrade your fleet, develop your NCOs, and face the consequences of every loss.

games.name: Exploding Judo Federation - Mors Blade Crossover Pack
Find The ZTA VI CD
games.summary: With your team of 4, there are no rules in this chaotic battle: Don't fall for fake CDs, throw objects at your opponents, and defeat them at any cost. The first to find the real CD and reach the police wins. It's time to put your friendship to the test! The real ZTA VI CD will be in your hands!

games.name: Freeze Line
games.summary: Time is coming apart. You wake in a clock tower — no memory, a warm pocket watch, and your master's charge: gather time's scattered shards and mend the world. Freeze time, aim your dash, slip past all that wants you dead — then return to the one who sent you, and a truth that rewrites everything.

games.name: Frog Collector
games.summary: Bring order to a shop overflowing with collectible frogs. Pick up and sort colorful figures, fill themed shelves, unlock helpful upgrades, and search for hidden eggs. Build your collection one frog at a time.

games.name: Frog is Crime
games.summary: Pet Run!Created by kids for kids!~~~~~FREE FOR A LIMITED TIME~~~~~Jump over obstacles, and survive for as long as you can in Pet Run, an epic side-scrolling endless runner!Pick from different animals and terrains, and challenge your friends to see who can reach the highest level!Made by Ishaan, a 13 year old developer.Half Baked Productions

games.name: GBald
games.summary: The maid asks if you have an appointment. It's your house. Take it back in GBald, a third-person arcade shooter. Dodge flying pots, fight through 30 waves of furious staff and roosters, and hit the gym between waves.

games.name: Grave Ambition
games.summary: They used the Overlord as a training dummy. Bad idea... In this casual voxel incremental action-RPG, every recruit you smash leaves a stat in your bones. Grind, evolve into new undead forms and climb seven floors to the five heroes who put you there.

games.name: Graveyard Orbit
games.summary: A satisfying incremental where you build the ultimate mining ship, loot every piece of an alien megastructure, and upgrade your abilities with an array of unlockable parts and skill trees. MINE. BUILD. UPGRADE. REPEAT.

games.name: Highschool J
games.summary: Yuki leads an ordinary life, weighed down by debt, shielded by a few friends, and consumed by poems he shares with no one. Until that transfer student arrives in class. Because some presences cannot be resisted. You can only surrender.

games.name: Let Me Die
games.summary: Let Me Die is a short incremental game about a hero trapped in a loop, fighting a monster. Unable to win, unable to die. Unlock upgrades, complete quests, create unique builds and maybe you will find a way to break the loop.

games.name: Ludoman
games.summary: **Ludoman** is a life simulator set in snowy Russia. Pay off a 250,000-ruble mortgage, work, gamble your money, and explore an open world. One life, complete freedom, and multiple endings. Your fate is in your hands!

games.name: Marque & Reprisal
games.summary: Explore. Trade. Fish. Whale. Colonize. Fight. Pillage. Survive. You are a sea captain in the year 1522, and the whole world is yours to discover in this roguelike sandbox historical sailing simulator.

games.name: Mini Legends Idle
games.summary: A voxel fantasy idle RPG about farming loot, leveling up and refining your build. Collect weapons and armor, upgrade your gear and unlock rare spells!

games.name: Mors Blade - UNSLASHED
games.summary: A pattern of notes will be played. Tap the pattern to continue. Subconsciously maybe you'll learn the notes.

games.name: MUV-LUV GIRLS GARDEN Mellow Days
games.summary: Muv-Luv Girls Garden Mellow Days is a productivity companion ADV where you work alongside Meru Momozono. Customize your Pomodoro timer, ToDo list, calendar, music, and ambient sounds. As you spend more time together, your story with Meru gradually unfolds.

games.name: Next Acre
games.summary: A cozy farming card merge game where you grow crops, raise animals, complete orders, and build efficient production chains to expand your countryside farm.

games.name: Patience Is Key
games.summary: Patience Is Key is a classic challenging 2D platformer game in which you will encounter difficult and tricky levels that will test your patience as the title suggests, and make you think about better solutions on passing the levels.

games.name: PLEASE CONFIRM THE DECEASED
games.summary: Night shift at the municipal morgue. Bodies arrive with paperwork, and the paperwork has to match the body. Weigh it, measure it, take its temperature — listen to its chest. The rulebook gains a page every night, and some of what you sign in does not stay signed in.

games.name: Shadow Grid
games.summary: If you're looking for high-intensity tactical combat, lightning-fast reflexes, and cutting-edge graphics, your next destination is Shadow Grid

games.name: Shoot'em & Scoot'em
games.summary: Aliens stole your horse! Saddle up, take aim, and blast across space! Every shot rockets you the opposite way and you can change directions on a dime. Can you rescue Scooty?

games.name: Space Golf - A golf game in space...
games.summary: Golf among the planets. Every planet pulls your ball: bend shots around moons, ride solar winds, slingshot past pulsars and land on tiny worlds. 12 courses, 216 holes, 4 clubs and a lots of ball styles — alone or with your friends.

games.name: Spaceship Wars Together
games.summary: Strap into a fully 3D starfighter and battle endless alien waves with up to 3 friends. Stack roguelite upgrades, chain class combos, fire your ultimate beam and bring down 11 colossal bosses - or turn your guns on each other in PvP dogfights.

games.name: Swarmbreaker
games.summary: Swarmbreaker is an incremental tower defense game where you must defend your base from a giant living wave of alien bugs. Build defenses to block their path, deploy heavy weapons, upgrade your arsenal, and break the swarm!

games.name: Thanksgiving: Tidy Up Together
games.summary: The feast is over and Grandma’s farmhouse is a gravy-splattered disaster. Pick up, sort and put away up to 2,831 plates, pies, pumpkins and forks with up to 7 friends, while golden hour fades into a cozy, fire-lit night.

games.name: The Last Gas Station: Winter Resort
The Red Bells Lament
games.summary: One day, she receives a letter from an unknown sender. Upon her arrival to the mansion indicated inside, she finds vampire hunters and royal knights. They're to form a squad and invade Nyx, the world of vampires. However, this is but the beginning of a game wherein the fate of her world is at stake.

games.name: The Retired Mage's Apprentice: Tidy Up the Magic Tower Demo
Thoth's Riddle
games.summary: Can you escape the Pyramid of Thoth? You have been tasked to explore the Pyramid and uncover its secrets. But you have fallen into the chamber and now must escape this mysterious Pyramid by solving 7 uniquely themed puzzles.

games.name: Tiny Dwellings
games.summary: Tiny Dwellings is a cozy pixel-art builder with over 1,000 hand drawn items to place, decorate, and unwind with. Create charming little homes and tiny dioramas at your own pace, surrounded by calm lo-fi vibes, soft lighting, and cozy ambience.

games.name: Warchaic
games.summary: Command your army, build your economy, and advance through the ages in Warchaic, a fast-paced online 1v1 strategy game. Deploy units, construct buildings and defenses, choose powerful cards, and outsmart your opponent to destroy their base.

games.name: WeirdBus
games.summary: One bus. Four wheels. A whole lot of bad decisions. Share control of an uncooperative bus, rescue flying passengers and cross cities, canyons, ice and swamps on the way to a megatower roof. Play solo or argue your way to the finish with up to three friends.

games.name: Whittle Warband: An Incremental Auto-Battler
games.summary: Build a warband, grow your woodland camp, and let your heroes fight. Choose a three-hero party, craft equipment, and shape your build with perks as you explore branching routes and challenge guardians in this pixel-art idle autobattler.

games.name: Auto Mutant Creatures
games.summary: A roguelite autobattler where your build can outlive your creatures. Assemble three mutants with risky powers and wild synergies, position your squad, and watch them fight. Choose a mutation and pass some upgrades to the next generation. Play Solo or asynchronous online PvP.

games.name: Bamboo Ronin: The Last Cut
games.summary: A retired ronin picking up his sword one last time, and a bamboo forest that has grown over his whole life. Cut your way through it one swing at a time, haul the pieces home, sharpen your blade and find out what's waiting at your old master's grave.

games.name: Black Border 3
games.summary:
Step into the inspection booth in Black Border 3, a thrilling dystopian border simulation game. Review complex documents, interrogate suspicious travelers, and uncover clever smuggling plots.

Earning your keep is crucial to surviving your 50-night assignment. Spend your hard-earned credits at the Supply Shop on tactical consumables, scanners, and speed boosts. 

Your shift is filled with difficult moral choices, unique characters, and even famous historical figures. Approve or reject them carefully, as your decisions lead to multiple branching endings seamlessly recorded in your Memory Bank. A single mistake could trigger a diplomatic incident, so choose wisely.

games.name: CASHGRAB
games.summary: Defeat enemies and grab your cash as fast as possible in this arcade time attack 2D platformer starring Joey The Duck!

games.name: Cheat or Fold
games.summary: Cheat or Fold is a singleplayer programming game built around Texas Hold'em. Write your own scripts, automate your play and manipulate simulated poker clients from a retro desktop.

games.name: Chigusa's Diary
games.summary: Chigusa was just an everyday schoolgirl, but once she began to notice the boys, her life gradually started to change in unexpected ways...

games.name: Cubey Cove
games.summary: Cubey Cove is a tiny, cozy island builder. Stack cubes into beaches, hills and ponds, plant woods and build a little village, and make each wish come true. Twenty animals sail, swim and fly in to stay, each with its own habits and a best friend.

games.name: DELIVERX
games.summary: An online game for four players in which you and your friends will need to deliver packages and escape from monsters. Deliver packages, level up, and try to deliver everything.

games.name: Dungeon Cooking
games.summary: Dungeon Cooking is a dark fantasy cooking roguelike about feeding a plague-struck town. Send heroes into the dungeon for ingredients, cook what they bring back, test ingredients on rats, heroes, or citizens, and keep the kitchen alive as the town slowly falls apart.

games.name: Empires of the Axis and Abyss
Fantasy Camp Builder
games.summary: A cozy campsite building game where you create medieval-fantasy campsites with charming decorations, warm lighting, and a relaxing atmosphere.

games.name: Faroda
games.summary:
Faroda is a challenging 2D platformer with colorful pixel-art graphics and chiptune soundtrack.

Travel across the 5 islands of a remote archipelago, completing over 100 levels, collecting treasure chests and many hidden gems along the way.

Will you be able to help Faroda, the protagonist of this adventure, gather the immense wealth scattered across these islands?

And most importantly: will you be able to find the legendary artifact?

games.name: Flame, Forest & Flood
games.summary: A cozy three-player strategy showdown where simple rules meet surprising depth. Easy to learn, endlessly re-playable, and built so everyone can play, and anyone can win.

games.name: Form
games.summary: Feed, observe, and raise FORM, a mysterious digital entity living on the RÆLOS desktop. In this atmospheric idle simulation, time passes even while you are away. Explore files, complete quests, play minigames, and decipher the traces left by every cycle.

games.name: Goat Simulator 3: Ticket to Dizzyworld
games.summary:
Welcome to Dizzyworld. An immersive goat-themed baa-musement park, letting you reach higher ups and downs than your mood swings. 

Did you manage to save the Multiverse AND survive the apocalypse?

Take a well-deserved break and feel the g(oat)-force on the many thrilling rides the park has to offer, turn innocent visitors into baalloons, watch them puke, and trade Dizzy Tokens for sweet rewards. 

Sounds like vacation to me. 

Secure your ticket today, enjoy the dizziness later.

games.name: Heavy Cargo - The Truck Simulator: Miami Vibes Pack
IT THINKS! - Build Your Own GPU
LifeStock
games.summary: FREE FOR THE DAY - Bugs everywhere! Crush the Bugs! The bugs rushed and ruined crops and homes. Use your powerful weapons and wisdom to destroy the bugs! It is your turn to exterminate those pesky critters to stop the infestation. * You pick your exterminating Ammo * 20 Challenging Levels with Crops and Homes to Protect How to Play: 1. Tap to start the Catapult 2. Tap again when you think the weapon should be launched from the Catapult Let the extermination start now!!

games.name: Lost Sock Simulator 3000
games.summary: Be a sweetheart and help Gertrude Knitmore find all her lost socks. An idle clicker about humanity's oldest unsolved mystery. And yes, there's an ending. The universe has opinions about your sock collection.

games.name: My Life: Safari Vet
games.summary: A lion cub needs your help – quick! Grab your vet bag and set off on a wild safari adventure! Examine animals, nurse them back to health, and discover Africa’s amazing wildlife. On foot or in your jeep, your next exciting animal rescue is just around the corner!

games.name: Mystery of the Mysterious Futayuri Mystery Dungeon
Puzzlozenge
games.summary: Rotate groups of three diamond-shaped tiles to restore the illusion of a colorful cube. Choose from eight puzzle sizes, ranging from 12 to 243 tiles, and race against the clock to beat your personal best. Simple rules, precise controls, endless challenges.

games.name: Salt of the Earth
games.summary: An isometric medieval city builder. You hold one manor by charter: lay the roads, work the fields, and raise hovels into town houses by meeting what each household needs. Winters take stores, the Crown takes dues, and raiders take whatever will burn.

games.name: Sardoinky
games.summary: Sardoinky is an oddly satisfying case-opening clicker. Rip open sardine tins, flip the fish inside, and cash in. Build a crew of oddballs to keep the cans coming, unlock auto-openers and powerful upgrades, and chase that one legendary pull. Strangely addictive.

games.name: Sokobomb
games.summary: Sokobomb is a puzzle game about blowing things up to find your way forward.

games.name: Spin It Lupin!
games.summary: Rotate four gems to form a matching 2×2 square! Clear all connected gems of the same color and trigger chain reactions as new gems fall. Enjoy 100 stages, high-score challenges, and local two-player versus and co-op modes.

games.name: Squircle
games.summary: Launch glowing neon shapes across a floating grid arena and sink them into matching holes, pinball-style. Chase a high score in frantic five-minute runs or play a course of handcrafted neon crazy golf. Two games in one, all using the same shapes and physics. Easy to learn, endlessly masterable.

games.name: Strike Warfare : Battle Fury
games.summary: Strike Warfare: Battle Fury is a fast-paced, story-driven military FPS that puts players in the role of an elite Army Captain undertaking an escalating counter-terrorism campaign.

games.name: Tun
games.summary: Tún is a relaxing gardening game with a light puzzle touch, where you plant seeds, discover new plants, meet kind characters, and shape a peaceful garden of your own. Weather, daily events, and the layout of each patch gently influence what to grow and when, adding a layer of planning without ever becoming stressful. Complete requests, unlock new possibilities, expand your space, and decorate each corner at your own pace. No game over and no pressure, only the quiet satisfaction of helping things flourish.FeaturesGrow a variety of plants through multiple growth stagesEnjoy light puzzle and strategy elements built around garden layout, weather and timingMeet charming characters and complete requests to unlock new stuffExpand your garden with new planting possibilitiesDecorate your garden and make it feel like homePlay at a relaxed pace with no game over and no pressureA beta test will be happening soon, so this is a great time to wishlist the game and follow its development.

games.name: ZapZap TV: 150 Microgames
games.summary: Grandma just wants to watch her soap opera finale, but Mr. Static has turned every TV channel into five-second microgames. Grab the remote and win them back: 150 frantic microgames, a channel-hopping story, endless remixes, a tower defence and couch duels for up to 4 players.

Sunstone of Time
games.summary:
Step into the role of a brilliant young scientist whose fascination with ancient relics leads to an unexpected journey through history. Sunstone of Time is a historical VR odyssey where exploration, secret discovery, and intricate puzzle-solving are your keys to survival in the vibrant world of the Aztecs, and your only hope of returning home!

After a groundbreaking experiment goes awry, you awaken in a distant past, thrust into an unfamiliar era. Explore breathtaking temples, ancient settlements, and sacred sites. Piece together forgotten knowledge, interact with a vibrant world, and meet unique characters, each with their own stories and motives. But danger lurks in the shadows: a powerful high priest is weaving dark schemes that threaten not only your fate, but the future of the entire world. Only your intelligence, courage, and insatiable curiosity can guide you through this ancient labyrinth of challenges.

Unravel a rich and engaging story as every step brings you closer to understanding Aztec culture and uncovering the path back to your own time. Will you rise to the challenge, reshape your destiny, and save the world?

When Chests Rain Tons of Loot
Persona 4 Revival
games.summary:
In the rural Japanese town of Inaba, the once sleepy streets receive a cold wake-up call when a mysterious serial killer strikes. Also, what's with the rumor of a mysterious TV channel appearing only on rainy nights? 

A whirlwind of surprises and otherworldly adventures will make the next year of your high school life anything but ordinary!

Persona 4 Revival intertwines an investigation into a string of murders with the journey of self-discovery and encounters with the occult, all within a critically acclaimed, classic RPG experience - reborn in a new form!
